lines.text: Photos: a RAW photo is ready to edit much sooner, at half size first; full detail follows by itself.
The editor uses several cores when it can, and its title shows how long the photo took to decode.
The editor has Looks: save an edit as a look, then tap one to apply it to any photo, with Amount up to 200%.
Undo in a Photos message now takes a tap (it did not before).
